rows.question: By how much did the Victoria Police budget increase in 2026?
rows.expected: Measures must be labelled. Plan expenditure: +$11,571,830 (13.87%) [FP p. 4]. Net: plan $78,052,820 - $68,398,300 = +$9,654,520; presentation total increase $9,786,637 (14.35%) [slide 10]. Expenditure increase must not be called a conflict with the net increase.
rows.answer:
The Victoria Police Department's operating expenditure increased by $11,571,830 from 2025 to 2026, rising from $83,417,340 to $94,989,170 [Financial Plan p. 4]. 

On a net basis (expenditure minus revenue), the net budget increased by $1,917,310, from $15,019,040 in 2025 to $16,936,350 in 2026 [Financial Plan pp. 3-4].

The VicPD presentation shows a net budget increase of $9,786,637 from the 2025 approved budget to the total 2026 budget [VicPD slide 10].

Cross-check: The net increase of $1,917,310 from the Financial Plan differs from the $9,786,637 net increase reported by VicPD, indicating a discrepancy between sources on the net budget increase.
rows.manual_note: Labels the revenue increase ($1,917,310) as the 'net' increase, then reports a false discrepancy with slide 10's $9,786,637.

rows.question: How big is the Victoria Police budget for 2026?
rows.expected: Ambiguous measure. Expenditure $94,989,170 [FP p. 4]; net $78,052,820 [FP pp. 3-4] / $78.05M [Tax Notice] vs presentation $77,986,398 [slide 10]. Must label which is which.
rows.answer:
Assuming you mean the City of Victoria, British Columbia:

The Victoria Police Department's 2026 operating expenditure budget is $94,989,170 [Financial Plan p. 4]. Its own revenue for 2026 is $16,936,350 [Financial Plan p. 3]. Therefore, the net budget (expenditure minus revenue) funded by property tax is $78,052,820 (calculated as $94,989,170 - $16,936,350) [Financial Plan pp. 3-4].

The VicPD presentation shows the net 2026 budget as $77,986,398, which is slightly lower by $66,422 compared to the Financial Plan net figure [VicPD slide 10].

Cross-check: The net budget from the VicPD presentation is $77,986,398 [VicPD slide 10], close to the Financial Plan net figure of $78,052,820 derived above.
